record.kind: marker passive with no PassiveEffects entry; the behaviour is driven by the ROTOM_CATALOG item's OnItemDroppedEffect and by each form's onAcquired / afterSell
record.summary: Passive.ROTOM has no combat effect and no PassiveEffects entry. Its only reader is the ROTOM_CATALOG item effect: when the player drops ROTOM_CATALOG on a unit whose passive is ROTOM, the unit is transformed (player.transformPokemon) to the next form in the cycle ROTOM -> ROTOM_HEAT -> ROTOM_WASH -> ROTOM_FROST -> ROTOM_FAN -> ROTOM_MOW -> ROTOM_DRONE -> ROTOM, and the item is not equipped (the effect returns false, which cancels the drag-drop). Each form's own skill, stats, range and synergies come from its class. Acquiring a Rotom form gives the player a ROTOM_CATALOG if they hold none; selling a form removes it.
triggers: Dragging ROTOM_CATALOG onto a unit with passive ROTOM (OnItemDroppedEffect)
Player acquiring a Rotom form (onAcquired: add catalog if absent), including via transformPokemon
Selling a Rotom form (afterSell: remove catalog)

effects.declaredRaw: next form in a fixed 7-step cycle per drop
effects.scaling: none (no AP, no crit, no combat effect)
effects.resolution: transformPokemon creates the new form from PokemonFactory, carries over permanent stats, dishes, position and held items, then runs the new form's onAcquired and updateSynergies

effects.declaredRaw: one ROTOM_CATALOG while any Rotom form is acquired; removed on selling a form
effects.resolution: onAcquired pushes the item only if not already in player.items; afterSell removes it

conditions: The dropped-on unit must have passive ROTOM; otherwise the handler does nothing (and still returns false, so the catalog is never equipped on any unit).
The transformation is a drop-time action on the player's board; it is not tied to fights.
Drag-drop is cancelled by the false return (drop-cancel).
record.resetBehaviour: No counter or stored state; the form is the state. Each drop advances one step; DRONE wraps to ROTOM.
